text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan hails Lebanese Prime Minister Hariri's efforts to help Lebanon emerge from years of civil war.
- Rightist parties known as Wifaq head 533 local councils out of 1,547.
- More than six tonnes of cocaine seized on Moroccan coast since last week, raising fears about use spreading among youth.
- Interior Minister Basri in Spain to meet Spanish Interior Minister Oreja on ways to fight drug trafficking and illegal immigration.
- Morocco, Lebanon to encourage bilateral cooperation.
- Hariri calls on Moroccan businessmen to take part in rebuilding Lebanon.
- Morocco's business confederation reappoints president, Abderrahim Lahjouji, for three years.
